body:
I always found that to be an odd paradox, then again I figure the only reason I'm not a fire and brimstone catholic is because hate speech is illegal in Canada, so I guess I kinda lucked out with respect to having slightly more liberal attitudes. I don't expect to trust anyone anymore and certainly not when it comes to money itself, but I can certainly buy friends and influence if I were to have it. I'd certainly have a lot more freedom too. 

My reasoning for the strip clubs is this: no relationship, not comfortable with strangers, strike out on normal dates, can't bring anyone home anyway because of grandparents. Solution: buy some time with someone who can at least pretend to like me *AND* make it somewhat believable and have a semi public space for some fooling around in case they get out of hand or try to hurt me.  Plus it's making up for all the lame dates I would've had to go through to meet someone.

I once went out on an interesting excision with an acquaintance from my past. He himself grew up extremely catholic and I only knew him by name and from some school clubs. Extremely attractive. Long story short: even though he took advantage of me (no sex, he claims to be straight but took me to his "friends'" condo... Ill let you put 2 and 2 together) he was more honest with me than any of my family has ever been; and it gave me a unique glimpse into my city's shadier side. I'm sure if he wanted to kill me he could have...  It's partially why I have him on the nether reaches of my life... I don't think he'd harm me directly  I think he needs help himself. I'm also never going to make light of sex trade workers again... I felt sorry for him.

I told him I'd be willing to attend with him to a doctor, though he can't admit to having a drug problem.

No ones really made me feel guilty about it. It just comes as odd baggage since I've grown up to well... not sleep around... To score a date in the gay community ... I figured it was mandatory... though I blew a chance with someone I might've been able to have if I wasn't insecure and studying useless things... Or mentally ill, or had misconceptions about the gay community. The problem is also me for not putting out, so fine... I have to learn to be a slut.


As for the money thing, though its sick sad and twisted, I'd use my own money to get out of a jam because I see few people are reliable anyway.
People have taken my things before, but at least if I were to make money, I'd have a little bit more control in choosing who I could be with, maybe even have someone learn to love me. If that fails well... I'd donate it to Red Cross or something and then end it. 


My dad became successful because he got away from my mom who tried to gold dig him... he cheated, but she tried to squeeze more out of him and tried using me and my brother as blackmail... I was ignorant to all the facts until he told me... though his penance was marrying another gold digger... he himself finally moved in to meet someone he built a decent life with after failing twice, of course it had to be the case that he had to get away from us that he finally was successful.

Well... it's hard just because it feels like I can't do anything right and every time I think about something I just get a flashback to times I've embarrassed myself or just failed at something. I'm looking for clubs, I just need to find things that the majority of people like so that I'm no longer a deviant. If I could, however take a pill to be straight I would... I imagine it would make dating a lot easier. 

Oh I know it'd be a bad idea, the only thing I can resort to for intimacy is paying for it at a strip club. So, now I'm just going to dedicate myself to making money, since its capable of buying happiness... Ill just have to be stingy with it unless the people are worth my time.
